regions.full_page: Synobitis Cured Harold C. Byrne 11 of 656 Hall Ave., Windsor, Ont. fell July 30 his birth-day losing use of right leg complete- ly - leaving little hope of recovery. On August 4th is enrolled for year. The boy delerious till that time with fever and pain, remarked that something must have been done that he felt so im- proved. The Aunt who enrolled him phoned next morning to find wonderful improvement as said the doctor. To-day he comes with his Mother to the Monastery. Sept. 20th not worse: still has temperature. May 1, 1927 Reported improving right along and in best of spirits.

regions.full_page: Cancerous Brain Tumer Cured? Joseph Ryan 41, Union Town Pa. to have operation on brain tumer is enrolled night before opera- tion Feb - 23 The doctors finding fearful tumer as about the brain and cancerous sews up incision in scalp and scull - 35 stitches - giving him one month to become entirely blind and in- sane. To-day Sept. 10 reported improving, after 7 months, Tumer seems to be going away, the patient who has a wife and three small children believes operation went off O.K. & successful - Dr. Temple Fay of Philadelphia marveled principal operater mar- veled when he saw him come to his office; --- Dec. 7th Reported as "set back" seemingly by repetition of x Ray June 14 '27 Fearfully suffering .... yet going to daily Comn.
